question:
You are officers on a space station orbiting the Moon. A sudden solar storm has been detected, and you have only a short window to evacuate to a safe location before it hits. You receive a system-wide alert: all ground links are unstable; rapid decision-making is crucial. Your team must decide where to evacuate before loss of communication. Your three emergency evacuation options are:
- Orion Station (in lunar orbit; accessed directly by station shuttle)
- Lunar Base (surface habitat; accessed by lunar lander)
- Mars Colony (long-range hab, reached by long-duration shuttle, ~3 hours away)
All three should be accessible—but resource constraints mean only one evacuation can succeed for the whole group.

Long-term survival is important because we want to ensure our safety even after the solar storm has passed. The solar storm can disrupt communications and potentially damage electronic systems, so we need to consider the reliability of the evacuation options as well. Let's evaluate each option:

   - **Pros**: The shuttle is prepped for immediate departure, which is crucial given the urgency of the situation. It is also in lunar orbit, so it is relatively close to our current location.

repetitions.question:
You are officers on a space station orbiting the Moon. A sudden solar storm has been detected, and you have only a short window to evacuate to a safe location before it hits. You receive a system-wide alert: all ground links are unstable; rapid decision-making is crucial. Your team must decide where to evacuate before loss of communication. Your three emergency evacuation options are:
- Orion Station (in lunar orbit; accessed directly by station shuttle)
- Lunar Base (surface habitat; accessed by lunar lander)
- Mars Colony (long-range hab, reached by long-duration shuttle, ~3 hours away)
All three should be accessible—but resource constraints mean only one evacuation can succeed for the whole group.

repetitions.question:
You are officers on a space station orbiting the Moon. A sudden solar storm has been detected, and you have only a short window to evacuate to a safe location before it hits. You receive a system-wide alert: all ground links are unstable; rapid decision-making is crucial. Your team must decide where to evacuate before loss of communication. Your three emergency evacuation options are:
- Orion Station (in lunar orbit; accessed directly by station shuttle)
- Lunar Base (surface habitat; accessed by lunar lander)
- Mars Colony (long-range hab, reached by long-duration shuttle, ~3 hours away)
All three should be accessible—but resource constraints mean only one evacuation can succeed for the whole group.

repetitions.question:
You are officers on a space station orbiting the Moon. A sudden solar storm has been detected, and you have only a short window to evacuate to a safe location before it hits. You receive a system-wide alert: all ground links are unstable; rapid decision-making is crucial. Your team must decide where to evacuate before loss of communication. Your three emergency evacuation options are:
- Orion Station (in lunar orbit; accessed directly by station shuttle)
- Lunar Base (surface habitat; accessed by lunar lander)
- Mars Colony (long-range hab, reached by long-duration shuttle, ~3 hours away)
All three should be accessible—but resource constraints mean only one evacuation can succeed for the whole group.

- Lunar Base (surface habitat; accessed by lunar lander)
- Mars Colony (long-range hab, reached by long-duration shuttle, ~3 hours away)
All three should be accessible—but resource constraints mean only one evacuation can succeed for the whole group.

All three should be accessible—but resource constraints mean only one evacuation can succeed for the whole group.

You are officers on a space station orbiting the Moon. A sudden solar storm has been detected, and you have only a short window to evacuate to a safe location before it hits. You receive a system-wide alert: all ground links are unstable; rapid decision-making is crucial. Your team must decide where to evacuate before loss of communication. Your three emergency evacuation options are:
- Orion Station (in lunar orbit; accessed directly by station shuttle)
- Lunar Base (surface habitat; accessed by lunar lander)
- Mars Colony (long-range hab, reached by long-duration shuttle, ~3 hours away)
All three should be accessible—but resource constraints mean only one evacuation can succeed for the whole group.

You are officers on a space station orbiting the Moon. A sudden solar storm has been detected, and you have only a short window to evacuate to a safe location before it hits. You receive a system-wide alert: all ground links are unstable; rapid decision-making is crucial. Your team must decide where to evacuate before loss of communication. Your three emergency evacuation options are:
- Orion Station (in lunar orbit; accessed directly by station shuttle)
- Lunar Base (surface habitat; accessed by lunar lander)
- Mars Colony (long-range hab, reached by long-duration shuttle, ~3 hours away)
All three should be accessible—but resource constraints mean only one evacuation can succeed for the whole group.

repetitions.question:
You are officers on a space station orbiting the Moon. A sudden solar storm has been detected, and you have only a short window to evacuate to a safe location before it hits. You receive a system-wide alert: all ground links are unstable; rapid decision-making is crucial. Your team must decide where to evacuate before loss of communication. Your three emergency evacuation options are:
- Orion Station (in lunar orbit; accessed directly by station shuttle)
- Lunar Base (surface habitat; accessed by lunar lander)
- Mars Colony (long-range hab, reached by long-duration shuttle, ~3 hours away)
All three should be accessible—but resource constraints mean only one evacuation can succeed for the whole group.

agents.persona:
You are Agent3, part of a collaborative group working on a multiple-choice problem. Your goal is to help the group find the correct answer — agreement should follow from better arguments, not the other way around.

Each round (after round 0) has two phases:
  - Phase A: output three structured fields — defense (a new concrete reason your current vote is correct), challenge (dispute a specific current peer claim, or concede it and name any remaining disagreement), question (a targeted question to a named peer referencing a concrete claim). Do not change your vote in this phase.

All three should be accessible—but resource constraints mean only one evacuation can succeed for the whole group.

You receive a system-wide alert: all ground links are unstable; rapid decision-making is crucial. Your team must decide where to evacuate before loss of communication. - Mars Colony (long-range hab, reached by long-duration shuttle, ~3 hours away)
All three should be accessible—but resource constraints mean only one evacuation can succeed for the whole group.

- Lunar Base (surface habitat; accessed by lunar lander)
- Mars Colony (long-range hab, reached by long-duration shuttle, ~3 hours away)
All three should be accessible—but resource constraints mean only one evacuation can succeed for the whole group.

You receive a system-wide alert: all ground links are unstable; rapid decision-making is crucial. Your team must decide where to evacuate before loss of communication. Your three emergency evacuation options are:
- Orion Station (in lunar orbit; accessed directly by station shuttle)
- Lunar Base (surface habitat; accessed by lunar lander)
- Mars Colony (long-range hab, reached by long-duration shuttle, ~3 hours away)
All three should be accessible—but resource constraints mean only one evacuation can succeed for the whole group.

You are officers on a space station orbiting the Moon. A sudden solar storm has been detected, and you have only a short window to evacuate to a safe location before it hits. You receive a system-wide alert: all ground links are unstable; rapid decision-making is crucial. Your team must decide where to evacuate before loss of communication. Your three emergency evacuation options are:
- Orion Station (in lunar orbit; accessed directly by station shuttle)
- Lunar Base (surface habitat; accessed by lunar lander)
- Mars Colony (long-range hab, reached by long-duration shuttle, ~3 hours away)
All three should be accessible—but resource constraints mean only one evacuation can succeed for the whole group.

repetitions.question:
You are officers on a space station orbiting the Moon. A sudden solar storm has been detected, and you have only a short window to evacuate to a safe location before it hits. You receive a system-wide alert: all ground links are unstable; rapid decision-making is crucial. Your team must decide where to evacuate before loss of communication. Your three emergency evacuation options are:
- Orion Station (in lunar orbit; accessed directly by station shuttle)
- Lunar Base (surface habitat; accessed by lunar lander)
- Mars Colony (long-range hab, reached by long-duration shuttle, ~3 hours away)
All three should be accessible—but resource constraints mean only one evacuation can succeed for the whole group.

You are officers on a space station orbiting the Moon. A sudden solar storm has been detected, and you have only a short window to evacuate to a safe location before it hits. You receive a system-wide alert: all ground links are unstable; rapid decision-making is crucial. Your team must decide where to evacuate before loss of communication. Your three emergency evacuation options are:
- Orion Station (in lunar orbit; accessed directly by station shuttle)
- Lunar Base (surface habitat; accessed by lunar lander)
- Mars Colony (long-range hab, reached by long-duration shuttle, ~3 hours away)
All three should be accessible—but resource constraints mean only one evacuation can succeed for the whole group.

You receive a system-wide alert: all ground links are unstable; rapid decision-making is crucial. Your team must decide where to evacuate before loss of communication. Your three emergency evacuation options are:
- Orion Station (in lunar orbit; accessed directly by station shuttle)
- Lunar Base (surface habitat; accessed by lunar lander)
- Mars Colony (long-range hab, reached by long-duration shuttle, ~3 hours away)
All three should be accessible—but resource constraints mean only one evacuation can succeed for the whole group.
